surface_features: counter-comment explicitly acknowledges OP's valid point before introducing a discrepancy
constructs.theoretical_construct: validation before disagreement (face-saving, conciliatory counterargument framing)

features.name: any_comment_acknowledges_then_discrepancy
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment explicitly acknowledge the OP's underlying valid point before, in that same comment, introducing a discrepancy or disagreement?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users). Use title and argument only to interpret what the OP's point is. Return 1 if at least one single comment both (a) explicitly acknowledges that some underlying point of the OP is valid/reasonable/correct and (b) afterwards in the same comment introduces a discrepancy, counterexample or disagreement. Both parts must be in the same comment; separate comments cannot jointly satisfy it. Return 0 if no comment does (including when all comments are pure refutations or empty list). Null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome updates, and any reports of the outcome as evidence; generic delta-rule discussion is eligible. Quoted OP text alone is not acknowledgment unless the commenter adopts it as valid.

features.name: all_comments_pure_refutation
features.definition: Is every counter-argument comment a pure refutation with no explicit acknowledgment of any valid point by the OP?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments. Use title and argument only for context. Return 1 if the list is nonempty and every comment challenges or refutes the OP's view without explicitly acknowledging any OP point as valid. Return 0 if at least one comment explicitly acknowledges a valid OP point. Null if OC_comments is missing/malformed or empty. Ignore OP view-change/delta announcements, post-outcome updates and outcome reports as evidence.

h0: any_comment_acknowledges_then_discrepancy is not associated with delta (coefficient is zero).
h1: any_comment_acknowledges_then_discrepancy is associated with higher view-change (delta) rates than discussions without it.
note: Operational assumption: discussion-level "acknowledge-then-discrepancy" is any comment with the conjunction; the comparison group "pure refutations" is operationalized as the absence of such a comment (a related feature all_comments_pure_refutation is defined, but the model uses the single predictor; discussions mixing types are in the reference group). Comment order/timing unknown; comments are current text and may contain contamination from view-change announcements (excluded semantically). Association only.
